messages:
Zara: quick life-update: I just got promoted to Senior PM (!), and also brought home a rescue pup this weekend. name is Mochi, shes 4 months and already stealing socks. :tada: :dog: would love a tiny office get-together Friday at 4pm for a quick hi-five and puppy meet-and-greet (totally optional).
Priya: YAY ZARA!!! congrats on the promo and the pupper :heart_eyes: I can bring cupcakes (nut-free).
Marcus: double congrats!!! does Mochi like treats? Ill bring some dog-safe cookies.
Liam: proud partner moment :relaxed: Zara has been crushing it. can we do 4-4:30 so folks on west-coast can join before EOD?
Zara: 4-4:30 works great. wanted to keep it short since Mochi naps a lot. pls label any food for allergens.
People Ops: congrats Zara! we can put a digital card together and order a small bouquet. Also reminder: service animals only in common areas per policy; friendly pets ok for short visits if owner brings crate and cleanup kit. Ping People Ops by Wed if you want us to order anything.
Sam: bringing tissues for happy sniffles :joy: can help set up a small mat for Mochi and a water bowl.
Marcus: will mark heads-down exceptions and add a 4-4:30 calendar block.
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Zara 3 Senior PM + Puppy Meet" Fri Jul 12 16:00-16:30 (Conference Kitchen). Invite sent to #all.
Zara: thank you all  overwhelmed and grateful. if you want to leave a short note for the card, DM me or add to the calendar event comments. Mochi may be tiny but she promises not to chew on keyboards (no promises). :puppy:
